tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for users to submit their code solutions.

tasks.name: Implement Code Submission Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to handle code submissions and pass them to the evaluation system.

tasks.name: Develop Code Evaluation System
tasks.description: Create the system to evaluate submitted code against test cases.

tasks.name: Design User Profile UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for users to view and edit their profiles.

tasks.name: Implement User Profile Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to manage user profile data.

tasks.name: Set Up User Profile Database
tasks.description: Design and implement the database schema for storing user profile data.

tasks.name: Design Leaderboard UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for displaying user rankings and scores.

tasks.name: Implement Leaderboard Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to calculate and serve leaderboard data.

tasks.name: Set Up Leaderboard Database
tasks.description: Design and implement the database schema for storing leaderboard data.

tasks.name: Develop Hints and Tutorials UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for displaying hints and tutorials for problems.

tasks.name: Implement Hints and Tutorials Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to manage and serve hints and tutorials.

tasks.name: Set Up Hints and Tutorials Database
tasks.description: Design and implement the database schema for storing hints and tutorials.

tasks.name: Test Problem Library Functionality
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure the problem library works as expected.

tasks.name: Test Code Submission and Evaluation
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure code submission and evaluation systems work correctly.

tasks.name: Test User Profile Functionality
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure user profile features work as expected.

tasks.name: Test Leaderboard Functionality
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure leaderboard features work as expected.

tasks.name: Test Hints and Tutorials Functionality
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure hints and tutorials are displayed correctly.

tasks.name: Deploy Problem-Solving Platform
tasks.description: Deploy the ACM Problem-Solving Platform to a production environment.

T1.implementation_approach: Create a user-friendly interface with search, filter, and categorization options for problems.
T1.notes: Ensure responsive design for various devices.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to handle problem data retrieval, creation, and updates.

T3.implementation_approach: Set up a relational database to store problem details, categories, and metadata.

T4.implementation_approach: Design an intuitive UI for users to submit code with clear instructions and feedback.
T4.notes: Include syntax highlighting and error handling.

T5.implementation_approach: Build backend APIs to process code submissions and manage execution requests.
T5.notes: Ensure secure sandboxing for code execution.

T6.implementation_approach: Develop a system to evaluate code submissions against test cases and provide results.
T6.notes: Implement robust error handling and performance tracking.

T7.implementation_approach: Design a profile UI to display user details, achievements, and activity history.

T8.implementation_approach: Create backend APIs to manage user data, authentication, and profile updates.

T9.implementation_approach: Set up a database to store user profiles, preferences, and activity logs.

T10.implementation_approach: Design a leaderboard UI to display rankings based on user performance.
T10.notes: Include filters for different criteria like timeframes and categories.

T11.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to calculate and update leaderboard rankings dynamically.

T12.implementation_approach: Set up a database to store leaderboard data and ranking metrics.
T12.notes: Ensure efficient indexing for quick retrieval.

T13.implementation_approach: Design a UI to display hints and tutorials with interactive elements.
T13.notes: Ensure content is easily accessible and well-organized.

T14.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to manage hints and tutorials content and user progress tracking.

T15.implementation_approach: Set up a database to store hints, tutorials, and user progress data.
T15.notes: Ensure scalability for large content volumes.

T16.implementation_approach: Test the problem library for functionality, usability, and performance.
T16.notes: Include edge cases and stress testing.

T17.implementation_approach: Test code submission and evaluation systems for accuracy, security, and scalability.

T18.implementation_approach: Test user profile features for data accuracy, security, and responsiveness.

T19.implementation_approach: Test leaderboard functionality for real-time updates and ranking accuracy.
T19.notes: Check for performance under high user load.

T20.implementation_approach: Test hints and tutorials for content accessibility, interactivity, and user progress tracking.

T21.implementation_approach: Deploy the platform on a scalable cloud infrastructure with monitoring and backup systems.
T21.notes: Ensure smooth rollout and post-deployment support.
